description: Source code for HD44780 LCD display driver, including initialization, command and data writing, position setting, and panic message display.

methods.name: lcdSleep
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified period, either via busy wait or thread sleep.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_write
methods.description: Writes 8-bit data to the LCD, handling 4-bit mode and optional I2C communication.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_write_command
methods.description: Sends a command byte to the LCD.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_write_data
methods.description: Sends a data byte to the LCD for display.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_set_position
methods.description: Sets cursor position on the LCD display.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_print_char
methods.description: Prints a single character, handling newline for position change.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_print_string
methods.description: Prints a null-terminated string to the LCD.

methods.name: lcdInfo
methods.description: Logs hardware port names for LCD control pins.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_init
methods.description: Initializes the LCD hardware and performs startup sequence.

methods.name: lcdShowPanicMessage
methods.description: Displays a panic message on the LCD.
